title: Recall Quiz: Pahari and Mysore Painting Schools

questions.q: The origin of the Pahari Painting School is closely linked to the migration of artists escaping the court of which Mughal Emperor?
questions.explanation: Aurangzeb is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: Which early Pahari sub-school is famous for its fierce intensity, primary colors, and the unique use of emerald-green beetle wings for jewelry?
questions.explanation: Basohli is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: The Kangra school of Pahari painting reached its classical pinnacle under the patronage of which ruler?
questions.explanation: Raja Sansar Chand is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: The Pahari painting style is universally celebrated for its:
options: Lyrical grace and serene depiction of the Himalayan landscape
questions.explanation: Lyrical grace and serene depiction of the Himalayan landscape is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: Who was the master artist instrumental in bridging the Mughal and Pahari styles, renowned for his work in Guler and Jammu?
questions.explanation: Nainsukh is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: The Mysore Painting School, originating in southern India, is distinct for its delicate use of which material to create textured jewelry on deities?
questions.explanation: Gesso paste and Gold leaf is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: Compared to the intense colors of Basohli, the Kangra style is characterized by:
options: Cool, refreshing palettes dominated by greens and blues
Heavy use of pure black backgrounds
questions.explanation: Cool, refreshing palettes dominated by greens and blues is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: The central thematic focus of most Pahari miniature paintings revolves around:
options: Vaishnavism and the divine romance of Radha and Krishna
Portraits of the British East India Company officers
questions.explanation: Vaishnavism and the divine romance of Radha and Krishna is the correct answer based on the lesson material.
From the hills is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: While Tanjore paintings also use gold, Mysore paintings differ by:
options: Using a more delicate, lower-relief gesso work with muted colors
Focusing strictly on secular court scenes
questions.explanation: Using a more delicate, lower-relief gesso work with muted colors is the correct answer based on the lesson material.
